recipe.visualDefinition: A geometric grid-based composition featuring a mustard-ochre plaid pattern overlaid with high-contrast, black-and-white photographic vignettes and a bold, mixed-typeface title block in the upper left.
coreVisualRelationships: Rigid geometric grid vs. organic photographic subjects
High-contrast monochrome vs. flat ochre background
Script vs. heavy slab-serif typographic tension
coreInvariants: White intersecting grid lines of varying thickness
Asymmetrical placement of rectangular photo frames

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four rectangular photographic windows of varying sizes scattered across the grid; the largest portrait is central-top.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A black horizontal title bar in the top-left quadrant containing three distinct typographic styles.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the dark title block, moves clockwise through the photographic vignettes, following the vertical white grid lines.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The ochre grid cells act as active negative space, balancing the heavy black photo blocks.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-saturation earthy yellow paired with maximum-contrast black and white.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mixed: Script, Extended Slab Serif, and Bold Sans-Serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary name in ultra-extended, heavy slab serif with rectangular serifs
Secondary text in all-caps, wide, geometric slab serif
Introductory text in a fluid, slanted formal script
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extreme horizontal stretching on the main name
High-contrast thick/thin strokes in the script
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Triadic contrast: Elegant script paired with brutalist extended slab serif and functional geometric caps.

preserve: Horizontal extension of the main name
The contrast between script and slab

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, extended slab serif aesthetic of the 1950s.
Provides the mid-century formal script contrast.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a mustard-ochre background with a white plaid grid. The grid should have varying line weights. Place four black rectangular frames in an asymmetrical layout: one large vertical portrait frame top-center, one small horizontal frame middle-right, one medium vertical frame bottom-left, and one medium horizontal frame bottom-center. Fill these frames with high-contrast, grainy black-and-white photography of male figures in suits.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a solid black horizontal bar in the top-left. Inside the bar, typeset three lines of white text: a script font on top, an ultra-wide slab serif in the middle, and a wide geometric slab serif on the bottom.

verificationChecks: Are the photos high-contrast black and white with deep shadows?
Is the main text ultra-extended horizontally?

adjustableVariables: Width of the black title bar
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or faces
The record label logo in the top right
postGenerationChecks: Check that the script text is legible against the black bar.
Ensure the plaid lines are perfectly horizontal and vertical.
Verify the photos have no mid-tones, only deep blacks and bright whites.
Confirm the ochre color is consistent across the entire background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Mustard-ochre field + White variable-width grid + High-contrast B&W photo inserts + Black header bar with mixed 1950s typography.
